mo_brief.title: 重要指令
mo_brief.original: Kill the designated enemies to provide footage for the upcoming inspirational education film "Democratic Sniper."
mo_brief.translated: 击杀指定敌人，为即将上映的励志教育电影《民主狙击手》提供素材。

items.original:

Significantly higher Scavenger numbers have been observed on the Terminid warfront.
items.translated:

ARSENAL AUGMENTATION

To bolster war efforts, the Shield Generator Relay Stratagem has been made freely available for all Helldiver deployments on the Illuminate warfront, for the next 48 hours.

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

The Ministry of Truth is producing an inspirational education film called "Democratic Sniper." Proceeds from the film will go towards construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights.

Much of the film will consist of real battlefield footage. The Helldivers are ordered to kill 300,000,000 Terminids, 65,000,000 Illuminates, and 50,000,000 Automatons in order to ensure the availability of sufficiently high-quality footage.
items.translated:
新重要指令

真理部正在制作一部名为《民主狙击手》的励志教育片。该电影的收益将用于建造麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心。

这部电影的大部分内容将来自战场实拍。绝地潜兵奉命击杀300,000,000个Terminids、65,000,000个Illuminates以及50,000,000个Automatons，确保获得足够的高质量录像。

items.original:
MAJOR ORDER LOST

Enemy aggression has denied the rightful return of certain territories to Freedom's embrace.

The Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights project is on rocky ground—a consequence that Democracy's enemies doubtlessly celebrate with glee. So long as our resources remain in enemy hands, our fallen heroes will suffer grave insult.

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

To honor the fallen, the government has authorized the construction of The Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. However, enemy aggression threatens this project. 

Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.
items.translated:
新重要指令

为了缅怀阵亡将士，政府已批准建造麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心。然而，敌人的侵略正威胁着该项目。

他们占领了超级地球的领土，那里富含稀有金属、原油和放射性同位素等资源，无异于窃取全人类的繁荣。简直是对我们逝去英雄的侮辱。绝地潜兵奉命解放费里、艾斯克尔和泽亚鲁戈西亚。

global_events.title: 重要指令
global_events.message: 真理部正在制作一部名为《民主狙击手》的励志教育片。该电影的收益将用于建造麦拉芬蒙河纪念碑与人权审讯中心，以及为阵亡士兵家属发放抚恤金。 本片以戏剧化的手法，重现了第二次星系战争史上最致命的绝地潜兵的故事，这名战士在32分钟的服役时间之内，可确认的击杀数超过4000。本片由库尔特·卡尔霍恩主演，他在2186年被评为最具民主风范的单身汉。 这部电影的大部分内容将来自战场实拍。绝地潜兵奉命击杀300,000,000个Terminids、65,000,000个Illuminates以及50,000,000个Automatons，确保该故事能呈现出符合预期的视觉奇观。

本片以戏剧化的手法，重现了第二次星系战争史上最致命的绝地潜兵的故事，这名战士在32分钟的服役时间之内，可确认的击杀数超过4000。本片由库尔特·卡尔霍恩主演，他在2186年被评为最具民主风范的单身汉。

这部电影的大部分内容将来自战场实拍。绝地潜兵奉命击杀300,000,000个Terminids、65,000,000个Illuminates以及50,000,000个Automatons，确保该故事能呈现出符合预期的视觉奇观。
